secrets.name: VITE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Manus platform App ID (from the Manus app dashboard). Required for admin OAuth login.

secrets.name: VITE_OAUTH_PORTAL_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth portal base URL (e.g. https://oauth.manus.com). Required for admin login flow.

secrets.name: OAUTH_SERVER_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth server URL used by the backend to exchange tokens.

secrets.name: OWNER_OPEN_ID
secrets.description: The Manus openId of the app owner, auto-granted admin role on sign-in.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL (for built-in LLM/image/map features).

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API key (server-side). Needed for LLM, image generation, maps.

secrets.name: VITE_FRONTEND_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API key exposed to the frontend (e.g. for Maps).

secrets.name: VITE_FRONTEND_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL exposed to the frontend.
